metadata.article_title: Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship by law

article.title: Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship by law
article.content:
11Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship by law

Article 11 · Part II
Nothing in the foregoing provisions of this Part shall derogate from the power of Parliament to make any provision with respect to the acquisition and termination of citizenship and all other matters relating to citizenship.
